# WO-303: CLI reference refresh

Vendor: grok
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via GROK_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: next (docs/tests only; never blocks a release)
Agent: Grok vendor team (one Grok session per WO)
Source: in-house batch 2026-11-09 (owner away; review on return)
Worktree: `.vendor-wt/wo-303` on `vendor/wo-303` from 0d9f43d

## Goal / acceptance criteria
Bring `docs/CLI.md` in line with the real CLI: run `../../.venv/bin/freemyid <cmd> --help` (with `FREEMYID_HOME` set to a temp folder) for every command and document what's missing or stale, notably `monitor` (and its monitor/1 JSON), `search-engines` (list/open/done/undo), `exposure` (`--old-addresses`, score-change line, coverage wording). Never run `run`, `send` or `schedule install`. `tests/copilot/test_cp_docs_match_cli.py` must still pass.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths
- `docs/CLI.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/copilot/test_cp_docs_match_cli.py tests -k "cli and doc"`
